families.additive: 18 parameters; newly refitted control only, no saved baseline modified
families.shade: 54 parameters; zone-specific nonnegative shade increments, common age/tare
families.vintage: 54 parameters; zone-specific nonnegative age increments, common shade/tare

method.regularization: ridge on global mean and zone offsets; additional shrinkage of each zone-specific increment toward global mean
method.selection: nested 5 outer / 3 inner group folds, 5 fixed seeds; inner balanced accuracy tunes alpha, pooling, tie band
method.groups: unordered provenance pair and shade pair; age/tare variants remain together
method.strengths: not fitted numerically; A/B/tie directions only
method.limitations: adaptive nonrandom evidence; repeated splits are not new samples; no pristine holdout remains; comparison family designed after Round 11; 54 parameters vs 158 rows needs strong regularization
method.interpretation: predictive preference scores, not dollar prices; tie band predicts elicited ties, does not change recorded equality semantics
